layouts.name: Sturup Raceway
layouts.description: Draft mapped route via Sturup Depå beside the paddock. The source retains the northern perimeter, western inner hairpin and southern return, then the separately named paddock road beside a parallel racing road. Its match to the operator’s full racing configuration is unverified. The original 1,993.3 m mapped source sequence and provisional travel direction are retained. No coordinates are stretched or moved to match a diagram or nominal distance.
